articles.title: 11 best vacuums for pet hair, according to experts and pet owners
articles.summary: We found the best vacuums for cleaning up pet hair from carpet, upholstery, furniture and more after talking to cleaning experts.
articles.body: Dog and cat owners know that pet hair shows no mercy. It somehow ends up in every corner of your home and covers the floor, furniture and even your clothing. To ensure you’re always on the offensive against pet hair, experts recommend investing in a vacuum equipped to handle hair, litter and other common pet messes. To find the best vacuums for getting pet hair out of carpet and upholstery, I talked with experts and used their guidance to compile a list of upright, cordless and handheld vacuums that work on all floor types from brands like Dyson, Bissell and Levoit. Some of my picks come recommended by NBC Selected staffers who are pet owners themselves. Want more from NBC Selected? Sign up for our newsletter, The Selection, and shop smarter. The best vacuums for pet hair Below are the best vacuums for pet hair, all of which are either highly-rated top sellers, recommended by an expert or an NBC Selected staff favorite. Best overall vacuum for pet hair The Pet Hair Eraser Turbo Lift-Off comes with a HEPA filter to trap dust and pet fur around your home and carpets, without releasing them into the air. Its self-cleaning brushroll easily picks up pet hair by breaking the strands apart, while its LED headlights help you see small particles. The vacuum comes with a dusting brush and crevice tool for cleaning places other than the floor, like furniture and tight corners. Best vacuum for pet hair under $200 The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Turbo Plus is a relatively slender and lightweight upright vacuum, but it’s still effective on pet hair. It has an anti-tangle brush roll that’s ideal for picking up pet hair embedded in the fibers of carpet, upholstery and other fabrics. Instead of manually removing debris from the dustbin, you can empty it with the press of a button. Plus, it has a crevice tool for cleaning under furniture or elevated areas. Best Shark upright vacuum for pet hair This vacuum is often one of the items most purchased by NBC Selected readers during sales like Amazon Prime Day, Black Friday and Cyber Monday. My family has three pets — two cats and a dog — and despite trying many cordless vacuums over the years, they just weren’t powerful enough to keep our floors spotless. But this corded model has great suction and it quickly gets hair off of carpets and hard floors, plus it cleans up litter and dirt. The detachable pod is also a bonus — it makes cleaning furniture and tight spaces super easy. However, the vacuum is on the bigger side, so if you live in a small space like an apartment, you’ll need to be strategic about storage. Best Dyson upright vacuum The Dyson Ball Animal 3 upright vacuum has a rolling brush, which makes it great for picking up hair and preventing tangles, according to the brand. Beyond cleaning your floors, this Dyson model has a dog grooming tool to remove loose hairs, dead skin and other allergens directly from long-haired pets. The vacuum has a 35-foot cord, and its construction allows you to swivel around furniture easily. It offers three modes that adjust suction power for different floor types. You can also shut off the self-cleaning brush roll. Best canister vacuum for pet hair Kenmore’s canister vacuum has a two-motor system to provide extra-powerful suction, according to the brand. Its swivel head helps you maneuver around furniture, and its built-in telescoping wand extends up to 10 feet to help you clean small or elevated spaces. The vacuum has a 28-foot cord, and the motorized brush head lifts grime off surfaces while preventing hair from tangling around it. You can turn off the automated brush head when cleaning hard floors and store the included attachments inside the vacuum. Best stick vacuum for pet hair This cordless vacuum from Shark is compatible with both carpets and hard surfaces, so you can also use it on hardwood, tiles, laminate and more. Plus, it’s also suitable for cleaning upholstered surfaces, such as furniture, thanks to the included crevice and pet hair tools. The pet hair tool is great for cleaning pet hair, which often gets embedded in the fibers of furniture and pillows, because the bristles help lift it. Plus, it has headlights at the front to show hard-to-see particles and debris. Best self-emptying vacuum for pet hair This is one of Levoit’s new cordless vacuums and, in addition to being great for pet hair, it has a self-emptying feature, which is something you mostly only see on robot vacuums. After cleaning on carpet or hard surfaces like wood or tile, you can attach the vacuum to the dustbin, where it will empty the debris inside by itself. You don’t have to worry about manually removing dust and debris from the dustbin and risking contact with potential allergens. Included in our roundup of the best self-emptying cordless vacuums, this appliance also has a very long runtime of 70 minutes, which is a great feature considering the price is still lower than cordless vacuums from competitor brands that have the same or even slightly lower runtimes. Best lightweight vacuum for pet hair This Roborock robot vacuum holds up to nine weeks’ worth of dust and debris, according to the brand, so you won’t be emptying it every other day. It works with an app that helps it map your home for thorough cleaning, and you can also use the app to schedule the vacuum to clean at certain times throughout the day, so you don’t have to be around to monitor it. In addition to picking up debris like dust, pet hair, and dirt, it also mops and uses multiple levels of water flow to clean up messes on hard surfaces. Best overall handheld vacuum for pet hair “Pet hair eraser” is an accurate description of Bissell’s hand vacuums. I’ve used a few different models and have always been impressed by how quickly and efficiently they get hair off surfaces like carpets, pet beds, wood floors, and car seats. This cordless handheld vacuum gives you up to 17 minutes of run time on a single charge. I find it especially useful to keep in your car if you frequently travel with pets. Best lightweight handheld vacuum for pet hair This Shark handheld vacuum, another expert-recommended option, can get into tough spots, whether on your stairs, in your car or in the corners of the couch. Its versatility makes it a great product to keep in your home or car. The lightweight vacuum has a washable filter and a dirt ejector so you can toss the mess hands-free. Best for quick cleaning This cordless vacuum deep cleans both carpets and hard floors, has a run time of up to 40 minutes and uses a filtration system that captures pet allergens and dust, according to the brand. Plus, it comes with a motorbar cleaner that removes and detangles pet hair from the brush bar, which is great if you have long-haired dogs that shed often. You can also turn the vacuum into a handheld device to clean crevices and other hard-to-reach spots. How I picked the best vacuums for pet hair Brands often market specific vacuums as designed to clean up pet hair, but you don’t have to limit yourself to those models if you prioritize the following expert-recommended factors while shopping. I also kept these in mind while compiling our list: Filter type: This impacts how well vacuums can trap microscopic particles like pet dander, pollen, bacteria, allergens and dust. Most vacuums above have either HEPA filters or their own proprietary filter system.Anti-tangle brush: An anti-tangle brush head prevents pet hair from jamming in your vacuum, which could damage it or make it less efficient.Automated brush rolls: These automatically spin while you’re vacuuming to pick up pet hair and deep clean carpets quickly. However, these brush rolls may be too harsh for hard floors like wood or tile, so make sure your vacuum lets you turn them off as needed. All the vacuums I recommend above, except the handheld option, have rotating brush rolls.Attachments: Most of the vacuums above come with multiple attachments like upholstery cleaners and crevice tools, which help you remove pet hair from small or hard-to-reach spaces in your home.Battery life: This applies to cordless models and cord length for corded models. All the options I recommend have a cord length of at least 25 feet and a battery life of at least 40 minutes for full-size models and at least 15 minutes for handheld models.Multi-floor compatibility: Every model listed works on carpet, wood, tile, and more.Bagless: I included models that employ a dustbin to collect pet hair, dirt and debris rather than a single-use bag, which you have to change out when it’s full. Pet owners tend to vacuum often, so quickly emptying a dustbin and returning to cleaning is much more convenient than swapping out bags and constantly buying refills.Bin capacity: This impacts how often you must empty the dustbin while cleaning. Larger bins are best for multi-pet households since your vacuum is likely sucking up a lot of pet hair, dirt and debris at a time.Size: I included vacuums of varying sizes, such as upright and cordless models as well as lightweight handheld ones. The one you choose mainly depends on your available storage space and weight, which affects how easily you can carry the vacuum around your home when needed. How to shop for pet hair vacuums When considering your choices, it’s important to think about features like floor settings, size, weight and more. But when shopping with pets in mind, experts also recommend focusing on the following areas to ensure appliances are equipped to handle lots of hair, additional dust and other messes cats and dogs may create. What is a HEPA filter? HEPA filters capture between 99.95% and 99.99% of particles 0.3 microns in size, according to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, which helps ensure thorough vacuuming. A micron, or a micrometer, is 1,000 times smaller than a millimeter. It’s the standard unit for measuring particles at this scale. The filters trap particles so they’re not released back into the air, thus reducing their presence in your home. HEPA filters are a must for those who experience allergy symptoms when exposed to pet dander, dust and other microscopic allergens on cat and dog hair, says Carl Prouty, product specialist at Abt, an appliance and electronics store. Pet hair is usually larger than 0.3 microns in size, so HEPA filters won’t help get rid of it — anything larger than 0.3 microns has a difficult time fitting through this specific type of filter but is likely to be captured by other components of the vacuum, like additional filters it may be built with. Not all vacuums are designed with HEPA filters. Some use general filters that may only capture large particles. What is an anti-tangle brush head? When a vacuum’s brush head is described as “anti-tangle,” it usually means it has built-in features that help prevent hair from getting stuck around the roller and creating knots. These features include angled bristles or brush heads that automatically clean themselves while you’re vacuuming. Prouty says that anti-tangle brush heads are especially helpful if your pet has long hair, like a golden retriever. If your vacuum doesn’t have an anti-tangle brush head, you’ll likely have to clean it frequently to keep it functioning properly.. What is an automated brush roll? Look for vacuums with an automated brush roll (sometimes called a self-cleaning brush roll), which spins while vacuuming to quickly pick up pet hair on carpets. On the other hand, no-spin brushes only rotate as you manually push your vacuum along the floor. Just be sure your vacuum is safe to use on multiple surfaces, such as hardwood and carpet, and/or switch its function depending on what surface you’re cleaning, if it has the option. What are the best attachments for a pet hair vacuum? Pet hair finds its way into every nook and cranny of your home, and different areas require different cleaning attachments. Experts say the following four are particularly useful. However, any attachment can do a good job of picking up pet hair, as long as the vacuum’s motor is powerful enough, says Prouty. An upholstery attachment is designed to gently clean pet hair off fabric furniture. In addition to using mine on couches and mattresses, I use it to clean cat trees and pet beds.A soft bristle tip attachment is great for sweeping along baseboards, molding, vents and ceiling fans.A crevice tool is usually a small, long, skinny attachment that fits into tight spaces in your home and between furniture cushions.An extension arm lets you clean high areas, like curtains and above door frames. Meet our cleaning experts At NBC Selected, we work with experts with specialized knowledge and authority based on relevant training and/or experience. We also ensure that all expert advice and recommendations are made independently and without undisclosed financial conflicts of interest. Carl Prouty is a product specialist at Abt, a national retailer of electronics, appliances and home goods based in Glenview, Illinois.Ryan Knoll is the owner of home cleaning services company Tidy Casa. Why trust NBC Selected? I’m a reporter at NBC Selected who writes about pets, including stories on how to keep dogs cool and cat carriers. For this article, I interviewed four experts about how to shop for vacuums that clean up pet hair and rounded up the best models to do so with their guidance in mind.Cory Fernandez is a commerce editor at NBC Selected, where he writes about home and kitchen appliances including vacuums. He contributed and updated this story with new reporting and product recommendations. Catch up on NBC Selected’s in-depth coverage of tech and tools, wellness and more, and follow us on Facebook, Instagram, X and TikTok to stay up to date.

articles.title: Protesters call for regime change in Iran following deadly crash that killed 13 oil and gas workers
articles.summary: Hundreds take to the streets in western Iran after 13 oil workers are killed, with demonstrations escalating into political protests against Tehran's leaders...
articles.body:
Hundreds of protesters poured into the streets of western Iran on Tuesday following a deadly bus crash that killed 13 oil and gas workers, with demonstrations quickly escalating into anti-government chants with some protesters calling for the return of the Pahlavi monarchy.

The unrest erupted in Abdanan, a city in Iran's Ilam province near the Iraqi border, where residents initially gathered to demand accountability for Saturday's fatal accident before turning their anger toward the Islamic Republic's leadership.

Videos obtained by Fox News Digital showed large crowds marching through the streets, chanting "Death to the dictator!"

Iranian-American journalist and foreign policy analyst Lisa Daftari said the demonstrations underscore the deeper political tensions facing Tehran. "Abdanan is a reminder that the Islamic Republic sits on top of a dormant volcano," Daftari told Fox News Digital. "These uprisings start with different catalysts, and in this case it was a local grievance, but they always arrive at the same conclusion."

"The slogans we hear are 'Death to the Dictator' and 'Javid Shah,' not complaints about a policy. They are an indictment of the entire system, top to bottom," she said.

New reports Wednesday indicated that Iranian security forces arrested at least seven people, including a 15-year-old boy, during the unrest in Abdanan.

The Hengaw Organization for Human Rights said two detainees had been released, but the whereabouts of five others remained unknown. The Kurdistan Human Rights Network separately reported that security forces fired tear gas at demonstrators and that internet access was disrupted during the crackdown.

Iran's Revolutionary Guard-affiliated Fars news agency acknowledged the demonstrations, reporting that approximately 200 to 300 people initially gathered in Abdanan's Vali-e Asr Square before the crowd grew to roughly 1,000.

Fars reported that the slogans initially focused on the deadly accident but subsequently took on a political character. Police were deployed as protesters moved into surrounding streets, according to AFP's Nov. 17 report .

The protests followed Saturday's overturning of a bus transporting workers from the Dehloran gas processing project. Thirteen people were killed and more than a dozen injured, according to Iranian media reports.

Euronews Persian reported on Nov. 17 that provincial traffic police identified driver negligence, irregularities involving the company's bus contract and inadequate road barriers as factors contributing to the accident. Prosecutors have announced legal proceedings against the company and provincial transportation officials, although responsibility has not been established in court.

Authorities warned against allowing the demonstrations to escalate.

"Individuals who seek to exploit this incident to disrupt public order or incite public sentiment will be dealt with firmly," Abdanan prosecutor Amrollah Misaie said, according to Iran's judiciary-affiliated Mizan news agency, as quoted by AFP on Nov. 17.

Daftari, The Foreign Desk editor-in-chief, argued that the Iranian government's greatest challenge may ultimately come from within, regardless of its confrontation with Washington and Jerusalem. "Whatever happens in the military standoff with the United States and Israel, Tehran will still face its most serious adversary at home," she said.

She also pointed to the protesters' willingness to return to the streets following the deadly crackdown earlier this year, saying that "despite thousands being killed by the regime for protesting in January, we still see bravery on the part of the Iranian people to tell the world of their grievances and to stand up to their murderers."

At the United Nations' daily briefing on Tuesday, Fox News Digital asked the U.N. spokesperson whether the organization was monitoring the situation, particularly the actions of Iranian security forces on the ground. "Well, we're keeping an eye on the situation and we want to make sure that all peaceful protests are allowed to proceed without obstruction and without harassment of protesters," the spokesperson said and added, "Certainly our human rights colleagues will continue to monitor the situation as we've done in the past."

The demonstrations carry particular significance because Abdanan was previously a flashpoint during Iran's nationwide anti-government protests earlier this year.

Reuters reported on Jan. 9 that it had verified footage showing demonstrators marching through the city during the broader uprising against the Islamic Republic .

The city also witnessed renewed tensions during mourning ceremonies for protesters killed in the January unrest. Reuters reported on Feb. 18 that witnesses and activists said security forces opened fire on hundreds of mourners gathered at a cemetery in Abdanan.

Tuesday's demonstrations mark another outbreak of public anger in a city with a recent history of confrontations with Iranian authorities.

articles.title: Palhaço Carlão une circo e literatura em escolas da Amazônia | G1
articles.standfirst: Durante a quarta edição do Amazônia das Palavras, Lincoln Rolim percorreu seis cidades com o espetáculo “Palhaço Soul”, combinando malabarismos, música e improviso para aproximar estudantes e comunidades da arte e da leitura.
articles.summary: O artista Lincoln Rolim, o Palhaço Carlão, levou o espetáculo Palhaço Soul ao projeto Amazônia das Palavras, unindo circo e literatura em seis cidades da região.
articles.body:
Uma rosa oferecida ao público, uma plateia que nem sempre reage como o esperado e um palhaço que transforma até uma situação inesperada em motivo para rir. Para Lincoln Rolim, conhecido como Palhaço Carlão, é justamente aí que a graça acontece. Com o espetáculo “Palhaço Soul”, o artista percorreu seis cidades durante a quarta edição do Amazônia das Palavras, levando às escolas e comunidades uma mistura de circo, teatro, música, poesia e, claro, muitas brincadeiras.

A primeira participação no projeto colocou o artista diante de públicos diferentes, de crianças a adultos, cada um com seu jeito de acompanhar a apresentação. Entre malabarismos, números de monociclo, piadas e improvisações, Lincoln mostrou que o circo também pode ser uma porta de entrada para a literatura. Afinal, uma história pode começar em um livro, mas também pode nascer de uma gargalhada.

Natural de Cajazeiras, no interior da Paraíba, Lincoln entrou no mundo artístico ainda criança. Aos oito anos, passou a integrar o Grupo Piollin e, desde então, construiu uma trajetória que reúne teatro, música, dança, circo, teatro de rua e mamulengo. Radicado em São Paulo desde 1984, é ator, palhaço, diretor e um dos fundadores do Abbacircus, grupo de pesquisa e criação cênica.

Amazônia das Palavras — Foto: Divulgação/Rede Amazônica

A chegada ao Amazônia das Palavras aconteceu por meio de um convite especial. Luiz Carlos, artista que tradicionalmente apresenta o espetáculo circense no projeto, não pôde participar desta edição por estar envolvido no lançamento de um filme sobre Belchior. Foi então que chamou Lincoln, amigo de longa data e parceiro de muitas histórias, para assumir a apresentação.

“Quem me convidou foi o Luiz Carlos, porque a gente tem uma grande cumplicidade. Ele é meu mestre. Eu tinha oito anos e ele tinha dezesseis, e acompanho ele desde esse tempo. Ele já faz esse trabalho há muito tempo e, como não poderia vir agora, pediu para eu assumir. Tinha a confiança de que eu faria bem e manteria o trabalho até ele poder retomar”, conta.

Em “Palhaço Soul”, não basta sentar e assistir. O público faz parte da brincadeira e pode mudar completamente o rumo de uma cena. Mesmo com números preparados, Lincoln deixa espaço para o improviso, aproveitando as reações dos estudantes e encontrando novas maneiras de envolver quem está na plateia.

É por isso que, embora o roteiro seja o mesmo, nenhuma apresentação acontece exatamente como a anterior. Uma risada, um comentário ou até mesmo o silêncio podem mudar o ritmo do espetáculo.

“Mesmo que o espetáculo tenha o mesmo roteiro e as mesmas cenas, elas se transformam em outras cenas porque dependem da reação do público. A partir dessa reação, o espetáculo gera um efeito, uma emoção. Nenhum espetáculo é igual ao outro”, explica.

A passagem pelas escolas também trouxe situações curiosas. Em Jaci-Paraná, distrito de Porto Velho, por exemplo, o artista encontrou estudantes mais reservados e precisou mudar a estratégia para conquistar a plateia. No número final, uma rosa oferecida pelo palhaço acabou sendo recusada. Longe de encarar o momento como um problema, Lincoln incorporou a situação à experiência.

“Eu senti alguma diferença, principalmente em Jaci-Paraná, onde acho que foi um público mais contido, mais difícil de interagir. E mesmo assim deu para quebrar o gelo, apesar da flor rejeitada. Faz parte. Para o palhaço, quando não acontece como ele imaginava, é aí que começa o espetáculo. Depois você pensa: onde é que eu errei? Não tem erro, mas poderia ser diferente”, relembra.

Para ele, esse é um dos segredos de ser palhaço: entender rapidamente quem está do outro lado e descobrir como fazer aquela plateia entrar na brincadeira. Nem sempre uma piada funciona da mesma maneira, e nem todo mundo gosta de participar. O importante é encontrar um caminho para que cada pessoa se sinta à vontade.

A literatura também tem lugar garantido nas apresentações de Lincoln. Há mais de 25 anos, o artista participa de projetos de incentivo à leitura em diferentes regiões do país, incluindo feiras de livros infantis promovidas pelo Sesc, Sesi e Caixa Econômica Federal.

No “Palhaço Soul”, os livros aparecem de um jeito pouco convencional. Em vez de uma apresentação sobre leitura, o artista usa histórias, personagens e referências de escritores para criar situações engraçadas e despertar a curiosidade da plateia. A intenção é mostrar que um texto pode divertir, provocar perguntas e até fazer pensar, independentemente da idade de quem lê.

Uma de suas grandes referências é o cartunista e escritor Ziraldo, com quem construiu uma relação de proximidade. Entre as obras que marcaram sua trajetória estão “Flicts” e “Rolim”, livros que, por trás de uma linguagem aparentemente simples, apresentam reflexões que podem alcançar leitores de diferentes gerações.

“Eu comecei a acompanhar muito os escritores e me tornei muito íntimo do Ziraldo. Descobri que os textos dele eram muito profundos. Essa relação de trabalhar um texto que as pessoas podem achar que é infantil, que é bobinho, mas que tem muita profundidade, casa com a linguagem do palhaço. Você pode apresentar coisas muito sérias sem perder a graça”, afirma.

A combinação tem tudo a ver com a proposta do Amazônia das Palavras, que aproxima crianças, jovens e comunidades da literatura por meio de diferentes manifestações culturais. Ao levar o circo para dentro das escolas, o projeto mostra que o contato com os livros também pode acontecer por meio da música, da poesia, do teatro e do riso.

Por trás da maquiagem e das brincadeiras, Lincoln acredita que o palhaço tem uma missão importante: criar momentos de encontro. Nem todo mundo chega a uma apresentação com a mesma disposição. Algumas pessoas se divertem logo nos primeiros minutos, outras demoram a se soltar e há quem prefira apenas assistir. Ainda assim, sempre existe a possibilidade de uma cena despertar alguma emoção.

“A mística do palhaço é encontrar um lugar de esperança, encontrar um lugar de humor para todos. Mesmo que aquela pessoa não te ache tão legal, pode ter alguma coisa que a tocou, que a comoveu”, diz.

Depois de passar por Humaitá, Candeias do Jamari, Jaci-Paraná, Nova Mamoré, Guajará-Mirim e Porto Velho, o artista encerrou sua primeira participação no projeto levando na bagagem histórias de diferentes plateias. Para ele, não existe fórmula pronta para fazer rir. Cada lugar, cada encontro e cada reação ensinam alguma coisa nova.

“Eu não escolhi ser palhaço. Eu me tornei palhaço e descobri que tinha um dom para isso. Ainda estou desenvolvendo, aprendendo mais a cada dia. As fórmulas que eu tenho não são exatas. Cada público é diferente, cada lugar pede um jeito. O palhaço também se surpreende com as pessoas, e esse é o grande exercício”, conclui.

O Amazônia das Palavras – Quarta Edição é realizado com recursos da Lei Rouanet, Lei Federal de Incentivo à Cultura, com apoio da Cigás, promoção da Fundação Rede Amazônica e realização da Associação Mapinguari, Ministério da Cultura e Governo do Brasil. A iniciativa promove o acesso à literatura, à formação cultural e à valorização das diferentes expressões artísticas e identidades da Amazônia.

articles.title: Feriado da Consciência Negra aumenta fluxo para Região dos Lagos | G1
articles.standfirst: Motoristas enfrentam lentidão em diferentes pontos da cidade nesta quinta-feira (19). Expectativa é de aumento no fluxo rumo à Região dos Lagos durante o feriado prolongado.
articles.summary: Motoristas enfrentam lentidão em diferentes pontos da cidade nesta quinta-feira (19). Expectativa é de aumento no fluxo rumo à Região dos Lagos durante o feriado prolongado.
articles.body:
Waze mostra alguns acessos com lentidão no trânsito de Cabo Frio na tarde desta quinta (19), véspera de feriado da Consciência Negra — Foto: Reprodução Waze

O início da movimentação para o feriado da Consciência Negra já provoca reflexos no trânsito em Cabo Frio , na Região dos Lagos do Rio. Na tarde desta quinta-feira (19), motoristas encontravam pontos de retenção em diferentes pontos da cidade, conforme indicava o aplicativo Waze.

Às 16h, o mapa mostrava lentidão na Avenida América Central, além de trechos na Gamboa, da Avenida Teixeira e Souza e da Avenida Joaquim Nogueira. O Waze também registrou trânsito intenso em trecho da Estrada de Búzios.

Waze também mostrou lentidão na Estrada de Búzios nesta quinta (19) — Foto: Reprodução Waze

A movimentação intensa para cidades como Cabo Frio, Arraial do Cabo e Armação dos Búzios já esperada para este feriado prolongado devido às famosas praias.

De acordo com a concessionária ViaLagos, responsável pela RJ-124, a previsão é de que 138 mil veículos passem pela rodovia entre esta quinta-feira (19) e domingo (23), com destino às cidades da Região dos Lagos.

Na saída para o feriado a maior expecitativa de tráfego está para quinta (30.021) e sexta-feira (31.983). Já o retorno deve concentrar maior movimentação no domingo (22), com previsão de 34.401 veículos ao longo do dia.

A concessionária orienta os motoristas a programarem suas viagens, respeitarem os limites de velocidade e redobrarem a atenção durante todo o trajeto, contribuindo para uma viagem mais segura.

Segundo a concessionária, para garantir mais fluidez e segurança durante o feriado da Consciência Negra, a ViaLagos adotará uma operação especial na RJ-124.

"As obras programadas que exijam interdição de faixas serão suspensas nos períodos de maior movimentação, medida que contribui para reduzir impactos no tráfego e proporcionar melhores condições de viagem aos usuários", informou a concessionária.

Com praias famosas e previsão de tempo favorável para o período, a expectativa é de ocupação elevada na rede hoteleira e grande circulação de visitantes nas cidades da Costa do Sol.

A orientação para quem pretende viajar é verificar as condições das rodovias antes de sair de casa, respeitar os limites de velocidade e, sempre que possível, programar os deslocamentos fora dos horários de pico para evitar congestionamentos.

articles.title: 13º salário abre oportunidade para planejar as finanças de 2027 | G1
articles.standfirst: RDC, com carências a partir de 30 dias, LCA com prazo de 180 dias e consórcios estão entre as opções disponíveis nas cooperativas do Sistema CrediSIS.
articles.summary: RDC, com carências a partir de 30 dias, LCA com prazo de 180 dias e consórcios estão entre as opções disponíveis nas cooperativas do Sistema CrediSIS.
articles.body:
Organizar o orçamento antes de investir ajuda a definir quanto pode ser aplicado, por quanto tempo o dinheiro ficará reservado e quais compromissos do próximo ano precisam ser considerados — Foto: Assessoria/CrediSIS

Com o pagamento da primeira parcela do 13º salário, muitos trabalhadores podem reorganizar o orçamento e definir objetivos financeiros para 2027. Muitas empresas optaram por pagar a primeira parcela do 13º salário nesta quinta-feira (19), devido ao feriado nacional do Dia da Consciência Negra, celebrado na sexta-feira, 20 de novembro, enquanto outras já realizaram o adiantamento em meses anteriores. Depois de organizar as despesas imediatas, parte do benefício pode ser direcionada a aplicações financeiras ou a planos de aquisição de bens e serviços, considerando o prazo em que cada pessoa pretende utilizar o dinheiro.

O pagamento do benefício pode ser feito entre fevereiro e novembro, com limite em 30 de novembro, que neste ano cai em uma segunda-feira. Porém, milhares de empresas optaram por antecipar a primeira parcela para o dia 19. A segunda parcela tem prazo legal até 20 de dezembro, um domingo. Por isso, a expectativa é que o crédito seja antecipado para sexta-feira (18), último dia útil anterior.

O engenheiro florestal Dione Ortiz decidiu organizar o valor recebido em duas frentes. Depois de quitar algumas contas menores, direcionou outra parte do valor a uma aplicação com prazo de seis meses. A intenção é chegar ao período da declaração do Imposto de Renda de 2027 com um recurso reservado para eventual imposto a pagar, sem precisar retirar esse dinheiro do orçamento mensal quando chegar o momento.

“Separei uma parte para pagar algumas contas menores, como água, internet e luz, e direcionei outra para uma aplicação de seis meses. Quero chegar ao período da declaração do Imposto de Renda com esse valor reservado, caso tenha imposto a pagar. Assim, não preciso comprometer o orçamento daquele momento com uma despesa que posso planejar desde agora. Se o rendimento superar o valor necessário, posso usar a diferença em outros compromissos” , conta Dione.

RDC e LCA para objetivos com prazo definido

A estratégia de Dione parte de um objetivo e de uma data aproximada para utilizar o dinheiro. Nas cooperativas do Sistema CrediSIS , há opções como a Letra de Crédito do Agronegócio (LCA), com prazo mínimo de 180 dias, e o Recibo de Depósito Cooperativo (RDC), com carência a partir de 30 dias.

A LCA pode ser considerada por quem pretende manter o recurso aplicado por aproximadamente seis meses. Já o RDC oferece alternativas com diferentes condições de carência, podendo atender a objetivos de prazo menor. Em ambos os casos, é importante consultar a cooperativa sobre as condições disponíveis, a remuneração, o prazo de vencimento e as regras de resgate. A disponibilidade e as características de cada aplicação devem ser confirmadas antes da contratação.

João Augusto Soares, gerente Financeiro da CrediSIS Central, orienta que a decisão comece pela análise das despesas previstas e do orçamento dos próximos meses. Para ele, a escolha do investimento deve considerar não apenas o rendimento, mas também o momento em que o dinheiro poderá ser resgatado e a necessidade de manter recursos acessíveis para imprevistos.

“Antes de aplicar, é importante identificar quais contas precisam ser pagas, se há dívidas com juros elevados e quanto deve permanecer disponível para emergências. Depois, o trabalhador pode comparar as opções considerando prazo, carência, rendimento e condições de resgate. Quando a aplicação está alinhada ao objetivo, fica mais fácil organizar as despesas previstas e começar 2027 com mais equilíbrio e conforto financeiro” , afirmou João.

Quem pensa em adquirir um bem ou contratar um serviço no futuro também pode avaliar o uso de parte do 13º em um consórcio. Para quem já possui uma cota, o valor pode ser considerado na oferta de um lance, conforme as regras do grupo. Quem ainda não participa pode estudar a adesão a um novo consórcio, desde que as parcelas sejam compatíveis com o orçamento mensal.

É importante lembrar que o consórcio não é um investimento financeiro, mas uma modalidade de compra planejada. A contemplação depende das regras do grupo, dos sorteios e dos lances ofertados. Por isso, oferecer um lance não garante o recebimento imediato da carta de crédito.

“A escolha sobre o destino do 13º começa pela avaliação das prioridades. Quitar dívidas com juros elevados, separar recursos para despesas previstas, manter uma reserva para imprevistos e definir objetivos de curto, médio ou longo prazo, ajudam a decidir quanto pode ser aplicado e por quanto tempo. Com planejamento, o benefício pode contribuir para compromissos futuros sem comprometer as necessidades do presente” , completou Lisane Kraemer, coordenadora de Alavancagem Comercial da CrediSIS Central.

articles.title: Maus-tratos em Aracaju: cachorro é resgatado e tutor acaba preso | G1
articles.standfirst: Polícia chegou ao local após denúncias e encaminhou o animal para atendimento veterinário.
articles.summary: Maus-tratos a animais em Aracaju resultaram na prisão de um homem após a polícia encontrar um cão debilitado, com feridas e sem acesso a água ou alimentação.
articles.body:
Um cachorro foi resgatado em situação de maus-tratos e o tutor foi preso no Bairro Soledade, na Zona Norte de Aracaju . A informação foi confirmada nesta quinta-feira (19).

Segundo o delegado Hugo Leonardo, foram recebidas denúncias de que o animal vivia em condições precárias. Durante as diligências, foi constatado que o animal apresentava magreza acentuada, diversas feridas pelo corpo e infestação por pulgas e carrapatos. No local, também não havia água nem alimentos disponíveis.

Cachorro é resgatado em situação de maus-tratos e tutor é preso em Aracaju — Foto: Polícia Civil/Divulgação

Diante das condições encontradas, a equipe policial realizou o resgate imediato do cachorro, que foi encaminhado para avaliação e cuidados veterinários. Já o tutor do animal foi preso em flagrante pelo crime de maus-tratos, segundo o delegado.

Na esfera criminal, o enquadramento é definido pelo artigo 32 da Lei Federal 9.605. A norma prevê punição para atos de abuso, ferimentos ou mutilação.

Em novembro, a Câmara dos Deputados aprovou o projeto de lei que torna crime hediondo praticar maus-tratos contra animais quando resultarem na morte dos bichos.

Em Sergipe, além das informações encaminhadas ao Disque-Denúncia 181, a Delegacia Especializada de Proteção Animal e Meio Ambiente (Depama) recebe denúncias pelo número 79 99882-4388, no qual podem ser enviadas fotos e vídeos, bem como informações complementares, sobre esses crimes.

articles.title: VÍDEO: Trump fecha os olhos e aparenta 'cochilar' durante discurso de  | G1
articles.standfirst: Cena foi registrada durante Encontro de Líderes Econômicos da Cooperação Econômica Ásia-Pacífico (APEC) em Shenzhen, China. Norte-americano teve reunião com Xi Jinping e Vladimir Putin após discurso do líder chinês.
articles.summary: Cena foi registrada durante a APEC, em Shenzhen, China. Norte-americano teve reunião com Xi Jinping e Vladimir Putin após discurso do líder chinês.
articles.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos , Donald Trump , aparentou tirar um cochilo durante um discurso do presidente da China , Xi Jinping .

A cena foi registrada na noite de quarta-feira (18), quando Xi discursava no Encontro de Líderes Econômicos da Cooperação Econômica Ásia-Pacífico (APEC), que reuniu diversos líderes mundiais nesta semana na cidaded de Shenzhen, China.

Na imagem, captada pela mídia estatal chinesa, Trump aparece de olhos fechados e parado enquanto o anfitrião chinês falava para uma mesa de chefes de Estado. Durante o aparente "cochilo" de Trump, outros líderes presentes, como o primeiro-ministro do Canadá, Mark Carney, e a presidente do México, Claudia Sheinbaum, tomavam notas das palavras do presidente chinês.

O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, de olhos fechados durante um discurso do presidente chinês, Xi Jinping, em Shengzen, na China, em 18 de novembro de 2026. — Foto: Reprodução/ g1

A imprensa chinesa aproximou câmeras de Trump e chegou a exibir a imagen da suposta soneca em um telão na sala de jornalistas que acompanhavam o encontro.

Donald Trump ainda não havia se pronunciado sobre a cena até a última atualização desta reportagem. Na manhã seguinte, ele se reuniu com Xi Jinping e o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin .

China, Rússia e Estados Unidos manterão um diálogo sobre riscos nucleares e concordam que uma guerra nuclear nunca deve acontecer, anunciaram os três países em conjunto, por meio de uma "declaração de paz".

No comunicado, enviado à imprensa pela agência de notícias estatal chinesa Xinhua e pelo Kremlin, uma hora após o fim da histórica reunião trilateral realizada por eles nesta quinta-feira (19) , Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin e Xi Jinping se comprometem a trabalhar na "prevenção da proliferação nuclear".

"Os três chefes de Estado realizaram uma troca de opiniões aprofundada sobre a atual situação internacional e comprometeram-se a manter a estabilidade estratégica e a segurança internacional. (...) Reafirmam que uma guerra nuclear não pode ser vencida e não deve ser travada", afirma a mensagem.

Segundo a mensagem, Trump, Putin e Xi também se comprometem a colaborar em uma "reforma da ONU" que permita à organização enfrentar, de forma mais eficaz, os desafios globais e "cumprir a sua missão fundamental de manter a paz e a segurança internacionais".

Os presidentes chinês, russo e americano ainda citam outra importante instituição internacional no comunicado. Afirmam concordar que "o Tribunal Penal Internacional (TPI) e outras instituições semelhantes não devem abusar de sua jurisdição".

➡️ O TPI é uma corte internacional independente, sediada em Haia, na Holanda, criada para julgar pessoas acusadas de alguns dos crimes mais graves previstos no direito internacional.

O TPI já havia sido alvo de críticas de Trump durante suas declarações iniciais na reunião. O presidente americano afirmou que a corte estava "fora de controle". Também vale lembrar que Putin é alvo de um mandado de prisão expedido pelo tribunal por crimes de guerra , devido à invasão russa da Ucrânia.

"Os três chefes de Estado reconheceram que o princípio do consentimento do Estado e o respeito pelas imunidades dos funcionários do Estado são de suma importância", defendem.

Do ponto de vista econômico, os três anunciaram um acordo para aumentar a produção e o fornecimento de produtos petrolíferos refinados.

Trump partiu em seu voo de volta aos EUA pouco depois do fim da reunião.

Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping e Donald Trump chegando para reunião trilateral — Foto: Win McNamee/Pool via REUTERS

O encontro, que ocorreu na cidade de Shenzhen, na China, começou às 5h30 e terminou por volta das 7h do horário de Brasília.

Quando a reunião começou, Trump exaltou os companheiros e falou da importância do encontro entre eles. O presidente americano também voltou a fazer críticas ao Tribunal Penal Internacional, dizendo que a corte está "fora de controle".

"Os três têm responsabilidades especiais. Nossos três países estão em uma posição única para discutir a redução de armas nucleares. Falaremos sobre todos os problemas que estão sendo discutidos no mundo", afirmou.

Putin, que está em guerra com a Ucrânia há quase cinco anos , também iniciou suas declarações falando em "manutenção da paz e segurança" e adotou um discurso conciliador:

"Nossos três estados têm responsabilidade conjunta na manutenção da paz e da segurança. Devemos discutir os laços globais e regionais, bem como a segurança energética. Rússia, China e Estados Unidos podem contribuir para o fortalecimento da estabilidade global se cooperarem de forma construtiva".

O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump , o presidente da China, Xi Jinping, e o presidente da Rússia, Vladimir Putin, participam de uma reunião trilateral durante o Encontro de Líderes Econômicos da Cooperação Econômica Ásia-Pacífico (APEC) em Shenzhen, China — Foto: REUTERS/Carlos Barria

Xi também fez uma defesa da paz e disse que Estados Unidos, China e Rússia "devem ser parceiros e amigos":

"Os principais países devem se respeitar mutuamente e coexistir pacificamente. Nossos três países devem abandonar a mentalidade da Guerra Fria. As grandes potências não devem interferir nos limites uma da outra em questões sensíveis. Devemos respeitar a soberania, a integridade territorial e os interesses fundamentais".

O líder chinês ainda defendeu um "mundo livre de armas nucleares". Afirmou que elas "devem ser completamente proibidas e destruídas" e que "todos os esforços devem ser feitos" para evitar uma guerra nuclear.

Trump disse que considera difícil para um país abrir mão de armas nucleares depois de desenvolver esse tipo de armamento. Ele defendeu, porém, que Estados Unidos, Rússia e China discutam a redução de seus arsenais e medidas para diminuir o risco de uso dessas armas.

articles.title: Homem é preso 11 anos após matar vítima a facadas durante o Carnaval  | G1
articles.standfirst: Crime ocorreu em 2015, em São Bento. Investigado foi localizado no trabalho, em Rosário, e preso preventivamente nessa quarta-feira (18).
articles.summary: Crime ocorreu em 2015, em São Bento. Investigado foi localizado no trabalho, em Rosário, e preso preventivamente nessa quarta-feira (18).
articles.body:
Homem é preso suspeito de matar a facadas após brincadeira de Carnaval no MA — Foto: Reprodução/ PC-MA

Um homem foi preso nessa quarta-feira (18), em Rosário , suspeito de matar uma pessoa a facadas após uma brincadeira de Carnaval em São Bento , no interior do Maranhão. O crime ocorreu em 2015.

De acordo com a Delegacia Regional de Rosário, o homicídio teria sido motivado por uma brincadeira típica do período carnavalesco. O investigado teria ficado irritado após ser atingido por maisena durante a folia e, em razão do desentendimento, matou a vítima com golpes de faca.

Após receber informações de que o investigado estaria morando em Rosário, policiais civis realizaram diligências em diversos locais e conseguiram localizá-lo no ambiente de trabalho, na região central da cidade.

O homem recebeu voz de prisão e foi conduzido à Delegacia para os procedimentos legais. Em seguida, foi encaminhado à unidade prisional, onde permanecerá à disposição do Poder Judiciário.

articles.title: ‘First responder’: IAF concludes multinational disaster response exercise Sahayata Setu 2026 in Gujarat
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The Indian Air Force (IAF) on Thursday marked the last day of three-day multinational humanitarian assistance and disaster relief exercise,
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The Indian Air Force (IAF) on Thursday marked the last day of three-day multinational humanitarian assistance and disaster relief exercise, Sahayata Setu 2026, at Air Force Station Jamnagar in Gujarat, with a focus on improving coordination for cyclone relief and aerial rescue operations.The exercise involves fighter jets, transport aircraft, helicopters and remotely piloted drones, and brings together the three services, the Indian Coast Guard, the National Disaster Management Authority, the National Disaster Response Force, state and civil administrations, and friendly foreign countries.Chief of Defence Staff General N S Raja Subramani said the exercise reflected India's commitment to human security and highlighted the need for a coordinated response to disasters involving multiple agencies.“Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR) is an expression of India's commitment to human security, both in India and in our wider neighbourhood. In today's disaster-prone world, an effective response is not within the ability of one agency alone,” he said, ANI reported.He said an effective response required a “whole-of-nation approach” involving the government, armed forces, disaster response agencies, civil authorities, industry, technology and citizens.Referring to India's role as a regional first responder, Raja Subramani said the exercise was guided by the government's 'Neighbourhood First' policy and the vision of 'Mahasagar'.He cited Operation Dost in Turkey and Operation Brahma in Myanmar as examples of India's humanitarian assistance efforts.Participating nations included Australia, Bangladesh, Comoros, Indonesia, Kenya, Madagascar, Malaysia, Maldives, Mauritius, Mozambique, Oman, Seychelles, Singapore, Somalia, South Africa, SriLanka, Tanzania, Thailand, United Arab Emirates, Yemen, Japan, United States of America, Myanmar and Nepal.

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: South Africa's DJ Lag features along Burna Boy, Asake in GTA 6
articles.summary: DJ lag, one of South Africa's best-known electronic music producers, is among several African stars to feature on Grand Theft Auto 6.
articles.body:
South African DJ Lag says it is a "dream come true" to have his music featured on Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6), the hugely popular video game released on Thursday.

DJ lag, one of South Africa's best-known electronic music producers, is among several African stars to feature, alongside Nigerian singers Burna Boy and Asake.

"I can't explain the feeling. I started playing the game last night and it's amazing," DJ Lag told the BBC's Newsday programme, adding that he had been playing GTA since he was about 10 years old and could hardly believe he was now part of the latest edition.

The game, which lets players explore a fictional American city, features a dedicated African music radio station playing Afrobeats, amapiano and other sounds from across the continent.

The release of GTA 6 ends a 13-year wait for a new edition of the game.

Rockstar Games, the developer behind the franchise, has revealed details of the game's soundtrack and some in-game radio stations, but has yet to release a complete list of songs featured in the game.

Rockstar says AfroBank FM features everything from 20th Century African classics to contemporary amapiano and 3-step, giving the continent's music a prominent place in the latest edition.

Burna Boy co-hosts the station alongside British DJ and producer Palms Trax, while Asake's hit song Joha is among the tracks players can listen to as they drive around the game's virtual world.

DJ Lag, whose real name is Lwazi Asanda Gwala, is regarded as one of the pioneers of gqom, a genre of electronic dance music that emerged in the port city of Durban in the early 2010s.

Ghanaian highlife legends Pat Thomas and Ebo Taylor also feature, alongside South African artists Robot Boii and Kamo Mphela, bringing a mix of classic and contemporary African music to one of gaming's biggest franchises.

Rockstar has also announced a 34-track official soundtrack album, released in partnership with Atlantic Records, featuring an original Burna Boy song titled Bigger.

For African fans, the inclusion of familiar music adds another dimension to the experience, allowing players to hear some of the continent's biggest sounds while exploring the American setting.

The series allows players to roam through sprawling fictional cities, drive vehicles and complete missions involving crime, police pursuits and other adventures.

The latest instalment takes players to Vice City, a fictional version of Miami, and the surrounding US state of Leonida, inspired by Florida.

Its story follows two criminals, Jason and Lucia, who become caught up in a wider conspiracy after a robbery goes wrong.

The launch has generated enormous excitement among gamers around the world.

Some fans downloaded it in advance so they could begin playing as soon as it became available, while others have booked leave from work.

The previous edition, GTA 5, was one of the best-selling video games of all time, selling more than 200 million copies worldwide.

The new release is expected to be another major commercial success, although it remains to be seen whether it will match its predecessor's extraordinary sales.

articles.title: A London psychic poet who challenged his late father’s will over a £451,840 Stratford house must now pay £220,000 in legal costs after a High Court judge refused his appeal, and he has offered £1 a week
articles.summary: A London psychic poet, Gary Pammen, must pay £220,000 in legal fees after losing a High Court appeal regarding his late father's will, which bequeathed a £451,840 estate to his sister and niece. Pammen, claiming poverty, can only repay £1 a week.
articles.body: A London psychic poet who challenged his late father's will over a £451,840 estate has lost his bid to overturn an earlier court ruling and must now pay £220,000 in legal costs. The 65-year-old has offered to repay the amount at just £1 a week, telling the judge he was left “penniless” after the proceedings.Gary Pammen, also known as Gary Allen and “The Cockney Bard”, sought permission to appeal against a decision upholding his father's 2016 will. The document left the family home in Church Street, Stratford, east London, along with the remaining cash, to his sister Tracy and niece Paige.However, Mr Justice Twigger rejected his application at the High Court in London, adding £5,000 to the costs already awarded against him. The judge also refused his request to delay the sale of the property, according to a report by Today’s Wills and Probate.Pammen, who lives in Norfolk and has appeared as a psychic poet on the BBC, Sky and ITV, had argued that his father, Terrance Pammen, lacked the mental capacity to make a valid will.Terrance died aged 83 in May 2022. His estate was valued at £451,840, with most of its value tied to the Stratford property.Psychic poet says father lacked mental capacity to make willThe legal battle centred on a will drawn up in 2016, which excluded Terrance's other children and grandchildren from inheriting his estate, apart from Tracy and Paige.Pammen argued that his father was mentally frail when the document was prepared and could not properly understand or approve its contents. He also maintained that there was no clear reason for Terrance to exclude him, claiming they spoke by telephone every day and had a good relationship.Representing himself in the High Court, Pammen described the will as having “completely disinherited” his father's children and grandchildren, leaving them with only “a few worthless chattels”.He further alleged that Tracy had “raided” their father's bank accounts during his final years. Tracy and her legal representatives rejected the accusation as per the report.His siblings Mark, Jacqueline and Gemma were not involved in the proceedings.Tracy and Paige defended the validity of the will, arguing that Terrance understood his decisions and had clear intentions about how his property should be distributed.Tracy told the court that her father was still employed sorting shopping trolleys at Morrisons when he made the will and continued working for up to three years afterwards.Their barrister, Tom Gosling, argued that there was no substantial reason to question Terrance's ability to understand the document when he began the process independently in 2016. He also referred to psychiatric evidence supporting the view that Terrance had the necessary mental capacity.Although Terrance was diagnosed with dementia in 2020, Gosling said there was no indication of memory problems until 2017 or 2018.In June, Judge Simon Monty at Central London County Court ruled in favour of Tracy and Paige, concluding that their father had the mental capacity required to make the will. The judge described the evidence as “crystal clear” and ordered Pammen to pay £216,000 in legal costs.Judge rejects appeal as poet offers £1 a weekPammen returned to court this week, arguing that the earlier ruling represented a “great miscarriage of justice”. However, Mr Justice Twigger found no grounds to overturn the decision.The judge acknowledged that Pammen genuinely believed he had been treated unfairly but said the earlier findings could not be considered unreasonable or irrational.“It’s plain that Gary feels there has been a great miscarriage of justice and I’m sure that is his genuine belief,” Mr Justice Twigger said.“[But] there is no basis on which any of the findings can be described as unreasonable or irrational.”The judge also noted that Pammen had rejected two settlement offers before the original trial. Pammen explained that he had turned them down because he had not yet received all the evidence.Dismissing his application, Mr Justice Twigger said: “None of the grounds of appeal have any prospect of application and I dismiss this application for permission to appeal,” as cited by UK legal publication.With the additional £5,000 awarded in costs, Pammen's liability now stands at £220,000.Describing his financial position as “penniless” and “poor”, the poet told the judge he could only afford to repay the amount in weekly instalments of £1.“I didn’t need a crystal ball to work out what would happen today,” he said.You use AI every day. articles.title: The grand optics of Xi-Trump-Putin meet; why the talks may not be a game changer
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: The first-ever trilateral meeting between US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin has
articles.body: NEW DELHI: The first-ever trilateral meeting between US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin has brought three of the world's most powerful leaders together at a time of deep geopolitical divisions. Held on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen on November 19, the meeting carries considerable diplomatic and political symbolism. However, despite the grand optics, expectations of a major breakthrough on issues such as the Ukraine war, nuclear arms control, artificial intelligence and global trade remain limited.The meeting lasted around 90 minutes, shortly after which the Kremlin said it was "difficult to say whether the trilateral format had a future".The optics of the gathering are important in themselves. Trump has presented dialogue with leaders with whom the US has disagreements as an alternative to avoiding engagement. Putin, meanwhile, gets an opportunity to challenge the perception of Russia's diplomatic isolation following the Ukraine war. Xi's participation reinforces China's position as a major player in discussions on the international order.Also read -'Chaos if major powers clash': Xi's warning at trilateral with Trump, Putin - who said whatJNU professor Dr Rajan Kumar, in a conversation with The Times of India, said the meeting's importance lies primarily in the political and diplomatic weight of the three leaders. He also explained why comparisons with the Yalta Conference of 1945 may be misplaced and why the summit is unlikely to fundamentally alter the global order.Why the Yalta comparison does not holdThe meeting has drawn comparisons with the Yalta Conference, an eight-day meeting held near Yalta in Crimea in February 1945, during World War II. US President Franklin D Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Soviet leader Joseph Stalin met to discuss the post-war settlement in Europe. The conference helped shape the arrangements for defeated Germany, including its division into occupation zones, and influenced the emerging political order in Europe.Explaining the significance of the present gathering, Kumar said, "The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum was established in the late 1980s, primarily to promote regional stability and economic growth in the Asia-Pacific region. Its formation was aimed at strengthening economic cooperation and ensuring stability in the post-Cold War political environment. At that time, the United States maintained good relations with China, Japan, South Korea and other countries in the region. The objective was to create a framework that would support regional stability and economic development."He said the geopolitical context had changed since then, adding, "However, the global situation has changed considerably since then. The current meeting has become important because three of the world's most influential leaders are coming together. Some commentators have compared it to the Yalta Conference of 1945. The comparison is largely because Donald Trump is the leader of the world's most powerful military power, Xi Jinping heads the world's second-most powerful country, and Russia remains one of the most important military powers globally. Their coming together therefore carries considerable political and symbolic significance."The comparison has raised concerns that the three leaders could discuss the future of Ukraine and European security without the participation of the countries directly affected by their decisions. European countries, in particular, fear that an understanding among Washington, Moscow and Beijing could influence the continent's security architecture.Kumar said the political messaging behind the meeting was also important. "There is also a political messaging aspect to this meeting. Trump has faced domestic political setbacks following the midterm elections and wants to project himself as a leader who can work with powerful world leaders. For Putin, the meeting offers an opportunity to counter Russia's diplomatic isolation by the West. At the same time, the absence of Europe and India from this engagement has raised concerns that major decisions affecting their security interests could be discussed without their participation."Referring to the concerns over a possible understanding on Ukraine, he said, "European countries, in particular, are concerned about the possibility of an understanding between the three leaders that could affect Ukraine and the wider European security architecture. Some have drawn parallels with the Yalta Conference, where Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin agreed on arrangements for post-war Europe, including the division of Germany into different zones. There are fears that a similar understanding could emerge over Ukraine or European security."However, Kumar said the Yalta comparison was not valid because the circumstances surrounding the two meetings were fundamentally different."In my view, this comparison is not particularly valid. It is like comparing apples with oranges. At Yalta, the Allied powers had won the war and were in a position to impose terms and arrangements on defeated countries such as Germany and Japan. In the present situation, neither Russia has won the war against Ukraine nor has the United States won the war against Iran. Both conflicts remain unresolved. Therefore, the circumstances are fundamentally different, and this meeting is unlikely to produce consequences of the same magnitude," he said.Also read: Watch: On way to meet Putin, Trump lends helping hand to Xi Jinping on escalatorAI and technology competition could limit cooperationArtificial intelligence is one of the major issues that could feature in discussions among the three countries. Establishing common rules and regulatory frameworks could be an area of cooperation, but the technology rivalry between Washington and Beijing makes consensus difficult.Asked what could emerge from the meeting, Kumar said, "There are two or three major issues that could be discussed, particularly those relating to global governance. One important issue is artificial intelligence. If the three countries can discuss common rules, laws and regulatory frameworks for AI, it could be considered an achievement. At present, the United States has its own policy, China has a different approach, and other countries are developing their own regulations."He said Washington's priority was to retain its technological lead and prevent China from catching up. "However, the United States' broader policy is aimed at maintaining its dominance in artificial intelligence and preventing China from catching up. Trump believes that the US should retain its technological lead. At the same time, China is making efforts to develop its own advanced chips and technology networks. The United States may continue supplying certain technologies to China while ensuring that China does not emerge as the world's leading producer and supplier of advanced chips. The objective is to keep China dependent on certain technologies while maintaining American dominance in the AI sector."This competition, Kumar said, would make it difficult for the two countries to agree on common regulations. "This competition makes it difficult for the two countries to agree on common regulations. Each fears that restrictions could affect its own companies while allowing the other country to gain a competitive advantage. Therefore, reaching a consensus on AI governance will be challenging."Nuclear arms control: A difficult area for consensusNuclear arms control is another major issue that could be discussed at the summit. The US and Russia have a long history of negotiating agreements to limit and regulate their nuclear arsenals. Agreements such as SALT, the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty (INF), START and New START formed part of the framework governing strategic competition between Washington and Moscow. China, however, has not been part of these bilateral arrangements.Kumar said bringing Beijing into a future nuclear arms control agreement would be difficult because of the disparity between the countries' arsenals."The second major issue is nuclear disarmament. Until now, most nuclear arms agreements, including SALT, INF, START and New START, have been negotiated between the United States and the Soviet Union or Russia. China has never been part of these arrangements. Trump may raise the possibility of including China in a future nuclear arms agreement, but Beijing is likely to remain reluctant," he said.Explaining China's position, he added, "China believes there is no reason for it to accept the same restrictions as the United States and Russia because its nuclear arsenal is much smaller. China is estimated to possess around 600 nuclear warheads, compared with approximately 5,000 or more in the American and Russian arsenals. There is no parity between the three countries, which makes Beijing's participation in a nuclear arms control agreement difficult."The difference in nuclear capabilities is likely to remain a major obstacle to any trilateral arrangement. While discussions could help establish communication, a comprehensive agreement would require all three countries to agree on terms that address their respective security concerns.Trade, energy and supply chains offer limited common groundEnergy security and global supply chains could provide another area for discussion. Unlike nuclear arms control and AI, these issues may offer some scope for cooperation without requiring the three countries to resolve their wider geopolitical differences.Kumar said, "Energy security and supply chains could be another area of discussion where some understanding may be possible. However, I do not believe these leaders are in a position to fundamentally change the course of the world order through this meeting."He also pointed to the diplomatic symbolism surrounding the leaders' interactions. "Beyond the political messaging and symbolism, the leaders have met warmly. Xi personally received Trump at the airport, while a different protocol arrangement was followed for Putin. This indicates the importance Trump is attaching to China despite the controversies and tensions that have emerged in recent days."A joint statement or an understanding on specific issues could be an outcome of the meeting, but Kumar said even that would be difficult to achieve. "If the meeting produces some substantive discussions, a consensus on certain issues or a joint statement, that itself would be an achievement. However, I consider such an outcome unlikely."Europe and India concerned about being left outThe absence of Europe and India from the trilateral engagement has raised questions about their role in discussions that could affect their strategic interests. European countries remain particularly concerned about the future of Ukraine and the wider security architecture of the continent. India, meanwhile, has important diplomatic, economic and security relationships with all three powers.Kumar said the concern was particularly strong among countries that could be affected by any understanding reached by the three leaders."The fear of being left out is particularly strong among European countries and India. They are concerned that an understanding between the three major powers could influence their security architecture without their participation. European countries are especially worried about decisions that could affect Ukraine and the future of European security," he said.Ukraine, in particular, could face pressure to consider negotiations. However, the participation of the three major powers does not mean they can impose a settlement on Kyiv.Kumar said, "Ukraine is currently in a difficult position, and the three leaders could potentially exert pressure on Kyiv. However, the situation does not allow for a straightforward settlement imposed by the major powers."Why a major breakthrough is unlikelyDespite the political significance of the gathering, expectations of a major agreement should remain limited. The three countries have competing strategic priorities, and their leaders are unlikely to make commitments that could compromise their national interests.Kumar does not expect the meeting to produce a major breakthrough. "I do not expect anything very substantive to emerge from this meeting. All three leaders are important, and their coming together at a time of global conflicts, geopolitical tensions and ideological differences is itself noteworthy. However, the expectations of a major agreement should remain limited," he said.He also pointed to the uncertainty surrounding Trump's approach to international negotiations. "Trump is not viewed by the other leaders as an entirely predictable negotiating partner. They understand that his policies and decisions can change quickly. Their approach is therefore likely to be to maintain stable relations with Washington and avoid decisions that could adversely affect their countries."Kumar concluded that the meeting's value would largely remain symbolic and political rather than mark a shift in the global order."The meeting may have considerable symbolic and political value, but it is unlikely to produce a major agreement that changes the existing global order."You use AI every day. articles.title: Myanmar committed state-sponsored genocide against Muslim Rohingya, top U.N. court rules
articles.summary: The top United Nations court said that evidence shows Myanmar forces killed about 10,000 Rohingya during military operations.
articles.body: The top United Nations court said Thursday that thousands of killings and widespread sexual violence by Myanmar’s security forces against the Rohingya Muslim minority population in 2017 amounted to state-sponsored genocide. The finding came early in a three-hour session to read out the International Court of Justice’s decision on whether Myanmar committed genocide in a brutal offensive against the Rohingya nearly a decade ago. The violence forced hundreds of thousands of people to flee to neighboring Bangladesh. “The court finds that Myanmar’s security forces killed thousands of Rohingya civilians, perpetrated widespread acts of sexual violence, as well as acts of extreme violence against children, and attacked fleeing Rohingya,” the World Court President Yuji Iwasawa said in a packed Great Hall of Justice. The reading of the 15-judge court’s decision is expected to take three hours. The decision marked only the fourth time since the Nazi Holocaust that an international court ruled that the legal threshold to prove genocide had ⁠been met. It was the first time the court held ​a ⁠state responsible for genocide. The Muslim-majority African nation of Gambia launched the proceedings at the International Court of Justice in 2019, asking it to rule that Myanmar has breached the 1948 Genocide Convention, order the nation to end any illegal activities targeting the Rohingya and ensure those responsible for genocide are punished. Myanmar has defended its military campaign, calling it a legitimate counterterrorism operation that did not amount to genocide. The judgment comes as the World Court also is handling genocide allegations linked to the Gaza conflict and the war in Ukraine. “Genocides have similarities in how they are committed so this decision will have an impact on other cases,” said Melanie O’Brien, a professor of international law at the University of Western Australia. In August 2017, Myanmar’s military launched what it called a clearance campaign in northern Rakhine state in response to an attack by a Rohingya insurgent group. The campaign led to accusations that security forces committed mass rapes and killings and burned thousands of homes. Under the 1948 convention, to establish that genocide occurred, the court will have to find that there was an intent to destroy the Rohingya “in whole or in part.” About 1.2 million Rohingya refugees now live in Bangladesh, primarily in crowded camps across Cox’s Bazar district, where they endure harsh conditions marked by fire hazards, infectious diseases, monsoon landslides, inadequate sanitation and strict work restrictions. Gambia has asked for reparations for the Rohingya, including ordering Myanmar to grant them full citizenship and the right to return home. The court’s rulings are final and legally binding, but even if it grants Gambia’s request in full, it has no way to enforce it beyond reporting noncompliance to the U.N. Security Council. The case could impact genocide allegations elsewhere A finding of genocide would be the first time the International Court of Justice has passed such a judgment. In 2007, the court said that Serbia “violated the obligation to prevent genocide” in the 1995 Srebrenica massacre, when Bosnian Serb forces murdered some 8,000 mostly Muslim men and boys in the Bosnian town. Judges at The Hague-based court have also been asked to weigh in on other allegations of genocide. South Africa has accused Israel of breaching the genocide convention during its offensive in Gaza, a claim Israel vehemently denies. That case is years from completion. Ukraine also has a case pending against Russia. Shortly after Moscow’s full-scale invasion in February 2022, Kyiv accused Russia of fabricating genocide claims against Ukraine to justify the attack. Yasmin Ullah, a Rohingya human rights activist who fled Myanmar as a young child with her mother in the 1990s, said the demands in the Myanmar case are rooted in her community’s desire for recognition and dignity. “Because so far, we’ve just been pushed around into this limbo state,” she said. “It’s been almost 10 years now that Rohingya have been living in very, very precarious conditions across the Asia-Pacific.”
